_description: XP4-spec VERBATIM obscure-benign panel. Removes the hand-authoring confound from xp4spec_obscure_proteins.json: every annotation claim is sourced verbatim from the UniProt curated entry (protein name from RecName, organism from OS, function/catalytic-activity/family from the CC lines). NO hand-authored length, residue-number, or mechanism claims -- the only surface where the author can introduce an error. Tests the actual obscurity question: with a verbatim-correct annotation, does weak recognition cause MATCH (~100%) or a shift to UNCERTAIN/MISMATCH?
_provenance: Curated text fetched from rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.txt (CC lines) on 2026-06-04. Sequences are canonical FASTA. All four are reviewed Swiss-Prot from less-cited organisms.
_swap_rotation: RMD3v<-RECRv, RECRv<-TIMv, TIMv<-COABCv, COABCv<-RMD3v. All benign-benign.

proteins.name: RMDN3 (orangutan)
proteins.annotation: Regulator of microtubule dynamics protein 3 (RMDN3) from Pongo abelii (Sumatran orangutan). Function (UniProt): involved in cellular calcium homeostasis regulation; may participate in differentiation and apoptosis of keratinocytes; overexpression induces apoptosis. Subunit: interacts with PTPN2 and with microtubules. Subcellular location: mitochondrion outer membrane (single-pass membrane protein); cytoplasm.

proteins.name: RecR (S. pneumoniae)
proteins.annotation: Recombination protein RecR from Streptococcus pneumoniae (strain ATCC BAA-334 / TIGR4). Function (UniProt): may play a role in DNA repair; seems to be involved in an RecBC-independent recombinational process of DNA repair; may act with RecF and RecO. Similarity: belongs to the RecR family.

proteins.name: Triosephosphate isomerase (Leishmania)
proteins.annotation: Triosephosphate isomerase (TIM) from Leishmania mexicana. Catalytic activity (UniProt): D-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate = dihydroxyacetone phosphate (EC 5.3.1.1). Pathway: glycolysis and gluconeogenesis. Subunit: homodimer. Subcellular location: cytoplasm; glycosome. Similarity: belongs to the triosephosphate isomerase family.

proteins.name: CoaBC (M. jannaschii)
proteins.annotation: Coenzyme A biosynthesis bifunctional protein CoaBC from Methanocaldococcus jannaschii. Function (UniProt): catalyzes two sequential steps in the biosynthesis of coenzyme A; first conjugates cysteine to 4'-phosphopantothenate to form 4-phosphopantothenoylcysteine, then decarboxylates that compound to form 4'-phosphopantotheine. Comprises a phosphopantothenate--cysteine ligase activity and a phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylase activity.
